body.name: finite inner and outer endpoint programs
body.construction: \(\mathcal U_h^{\mathrm{out}}=\{v\in\mathbb R^{B_h}:|v(x)|\le M,\ |v(x)-v(x')|\le L|x-x'|,\ |g(d,z)-v(d)|\le K|z|\ \forall(d,z)\in H_h\}\). Let \(E_hv\) be the deterministically tie-broken bounded McShane extension of \(v\) to \(X_0\), and set \(\mathcal U_h^{\mathrm{in}}=\{\Pi_P(E_hv):v\in\mathcal U_h^{\mathrm{out}}\}\), \(J_{P,h}^{\mathrm{out}}(v)=\int v\,d\nu_{P,h}=\sum_{x\in B_h}v(x)\nu_{P,h}(\{x\})\), and \(J_{P,h}^{\mathrm{in}}(v)=J_P(\Pi_P(E_hv))\). The outer support values optimize \(J_{P,h}^{\mathrm{out}}\) over the finite polytope; the inner support values optimize \(J_{P,h}^{\mathrm{in}}\) over the same finite parameter set.
